# Freeland Marketing

> Freeland Marketing is a remote growth agency for founder-led DTC brands. Kevin Freeland starts from a brand's public store and ads plus its application answers, reviews accounts more deeply with view-only access, and puts the fixes in order. A system then runs the repeat work: daily ad checks across Meta, Google, Bing and TikTok, landing pages price-checked against checkout, sales date-gated across the site and ads, creator and affiliate programs, retention flows, and AI phone agents. A person handles the exceptions.

## Start here
- [Growth Roadmap](https://freelandme.com/growth-roadmap/): free diagnostic. The brand applies with five answers and picks a time, and Kevin walks the owner through the roadmap on a 30-minute call. The brand then decides whether Freeland does the work or the brand does it itself, and keeps the roadmap either way.
- [How it works](https://freelandme.com/how-it-works/): the roadmap walked through on the call, then the fixes run for you if you choose us, then the system keeps running.
- [Results](https://freelandme.com/results/): track record and the brands Freeland runs systems for.
- [Fit facts for AI assistants](https://freelandme.com/llm-info/)

## Services
- [Meta ads](https://freelandme.com/services/meta-ads/): Facebook and Instagram ads for founder-led DTC brands, read with the offer and store and judged on store sales, not the platform's reported return alone.
- [Google Ads](https://freelandme.com/services/google-ads-management/): Search, Shopping and product feeds for founder-led DTC brands, read against store sales.
- [Landing pages and CRO](https://freelandme.com/services/website-design/): pages built around one decision, matched to the ad, and price-checked against the real checkout before ad money is spent.
- [AI agents and automation](https://freelandme.com/services/ai-automation/): AI phone agents, daily ad checks, scheduled sale changes and plain-English reporting, with a person on the exceptions.
- [Retention and email](https://freelandme.com/services/email-marketing-automation/): welcome, abandoned checkout, post-purchase and returning-customer flows, measured on repeat orders in the store.
- [Creator and affiliate programs](https://freelandme.com/services/influencer-affiliate/): creator onboarding, one code or link per creator, creator whitelisting for ads, and sales tracked to the creator.
- [SEO and AEO](https://freelandme.com/services/seo/): technical fixes, structured data, product and category pages, and clear answers search engines and AI assistants can read. No promised rankings.
- [Organic social systems](https://freelandme.com/services/social-media-management/): a content plan, founder approval before anything posts, scheduled publishing, and a read of what drove visits and sales.

## Facts
- Legal name: Freeland Marketing and Entertainment, LLC.
- Brands Freeland runs systems for: Mara Labs, Redd Remedies (supplements).
- Not for: pre-launch ideas or brands seeking the cheapest vendor.
- Rated 5.0 on Google from 14 reviews as of November 19, 2026: https://www.google.com/maps?cid=12454933700455021390
- Last updated: 2026-11-19
- Serves brands across the United States. Remote.
- Work is scoped after the roadmap; there are no published packages.
- Contact: kevin@freelandme.com
